status: source-file native gear draft; full-model proof pending

source.ownership: All 18 original chunks retained. Fused file has no independently trustworthy wheel rig nodes.
source.measurement: Complete original transformed triangles used for offline line intersections. No source topology or buffers enter the runtime. Visible surface scalars define original turned solids and native articulated gear.

road.inference: Circular fits to the exposed lower wheel arcs; hidden upper arcs, axle backs and bearing contacts are mechanical reconstructions, not source-owned joints.
road.form: Closed original steel bowl with six curved pressed recesses, raised annular rim and small stepped hub; no opaque rubber center or proud star plate.

track.ground: Sixteen live physical shoe phases remain at or above ground within 0.5 mm tolerance; rest minimum is +6 mm.

endFits.method: Twenty-one complete-source outer-course sections per end, at Y0.50 through1.00 in25mm steps; tooth-phase radial residuals reach23mm. Above1.00 the front scan includes the separate overhanging fender and is not used for the circular fit.
endFits.courseAccounting: Native KIT adds45mm wrap clearance to body radius; physical shoe stock supplies the remaining outer reach. No misleading trackR-only input or altered axle/course is used to clear hull conflicts.
endFits.limitation: End wheels retain the native pressed-family radial construction. Although the measured idler hub/lower bowl and sprocket hub axial witnesses match, the rear source has a broader proud off-hub shoulder: at right Y0.70/Z-2.85 sourceX1.664887 versus nativeX1.560800 (104mm local deficit). This is an explicit unfinished form limitation, not claimed source-exact or removed from comparison.

concealedSuspensionAccommodation.basis: Mechanical inference behind source-measured wheel bowls, not source-owned axle geometry. The prior symmetric arm penetrated the narrower left bowl by about16mm.
concealedSuspensionAccommodation.verification: Both-LOD actual arm/wheel triangle samples exceed the unchanged20.35mm clearance floor. Double-sided closed-stock rays establish more than2mm positive overlap at every arm/anchor boss, arm/spindle and spindle/wheel-core joint.
concealedSuspensionAccommodation.preserved: All seven road stations per side, source wheel faces, end axles, roller stations, track lanes, loop points and physical shoe geometry remain unchanged.

concealedHullAccommodation.reason: The fused file does not expose a separate upper return course. Its low solid shoulder conflicts with a mechanically continuous native belt using the independently fitted visible end wraps. No visible roof or outer lip and no gear axes are displaced.
concealedHullAccommodation.authorization: Root authorized bounded internal wheel-well relief and then the narrow concealed right lower-tip upturn below. Original roof planes and outerX stations remain; this is a disclosed mechanical accommodation, not source geometry proof.

rightTipUpturn.qualification: The source anchor/normal are measured full-source hits; extension into the concealed native corner is an inference. The42mm upturn is mechanical clearance, not a claimed source vertex.38mm gave18.809mm physical separation. A read-only41mm counterfactual on the limiting original triangle edge gives19.756mm, still below20mm;42mm is the smallest whole-mm lift meeting20mm.
rightTipUpturn.beforeFinding: No physical intersection; two20mm audit cells straddled the3.2mm near gap. No scanner change or exclusion was made.
rightTipUpturn.actualStrictHighLow: Front/rear/full-sweep BAND0 and SHOE0 after the mechanical relief.
